uncited: This family encompasses methods that generate or represent 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) primitives using hybrid feature grids or diffusion models, rather than relying solely on iterative per-scene optimization.
*   **Amplitude companding:** Apply a reversible log mapping to rebalance the training signal.
*   **Temporal conditioning (for sequences):** Stack the previous frame onto the input as an extra channel.
Results show negligible influence on segmentation outcomes (mIoU ~90%).
The family emerged to address computational bottlenecks and multi-view inconsistencies inherent in iterative 3DGS optimization pipelines.
